changes.description: [Enhancement] Added the **Hooks options** section with a `hook_excluded_buttons` input. Selected buttons no longer fire `ahb_controller_event`, so a custom action on a button is not raced by a Hook mapped to the same button (e.g. the Media Player Hook maps Dots1/Dots2 short press to stop/toggle). Default is empty, which keeps the previous behaviour. ([@Nicolai-](https://github.com/Nicolai-))
